initial_plan.answerable_part: The weekday distribution of police-reported crash records dated from 2013 through 2025.
initial_plan.denominator: No separate denominator; each qualifying crash record counts once.
initial_plan.population: Crash records with a valid crash_date from 2013-01-01 through 2025-12-31 inclusive.
filters: crash_date is in calendar years 2013 through 2025
initial_plan.grouping: Day of week derived from crash_date, Monday through Sunday

data_check_interpretation.facts: The selected population has 2,132,218 rows: every year 2013-2025 has rows and min/max dates span January 1 through December 31. There are 0 NULL crash_date values among rows satisfying the date filter; the DATE type plus the filter excludes empty or impossible date values. Standard date sentinels such as 1900-01-01 and 1970-01-01 lie outside the selected years.
data_check_interpretation.decisions: Retain every row with a crash_date in 2013-2025 and assign its weekday from that date. No qualifying rows are dropped or placed in an unknown-weekday group. Missing dates outside the selected date window cannot be assigned to a year or weekday and are not part of this population.
data_check_interpretation.change: No change to the initial population or metric. All 13 years have full calendar-year min/max date extents; this establishes the observed date span, but not independent completeness of the source records within each year.

final_plan.answerable_part: The distribution of police-reported crash records by weekday over 2013-2025.
final_plan.denominator: No separate denominator; each qualifying crash record counts once.
final_plan.population: Crash records with a valid crash_date from 2013-01-01 through 2025-12-31 inclusive.
filters: crash_date is in calendar years 2013 through 2025
final_plan.years: 2013-2025 inclusive; observed min/max dates span each full calendar year
final_plan.grouping: Day of week derived from crash_date, Monday through Sunday
final_plan.data_check_decisions: Use all selected rows; no selected rows have missing/invalid dates, and no year is partial by observed min/max. Rows outside the date window, including any undated rows, do not enter the population.
final_plan.limitations: These are police-reported records, not all crashes or a measure of per-trip/per-mile risk. Full-year min/max dates do not independently verify source completeness within the interval; the data check excludes dates outside 2013-2025 and does not quantify undated rows.
